name.comment: Derived from sourceName (falls back to sourceId) by the DeriveName hook.

oAuthAccount.comment: Meta OAuthAccount whose token authorizes this source. Selecting it scopes the source picker.

sourceId.comment: WhatsApp Business Account ID (whatsapp) or Instagram business account ID (instagram). Sent as user_data.whatsapp_business_account_id / instagram_business_account_id. Unique per channel.

chatwootInboxIntegration.comment: Chatwoot inbox this source maps to. Inbound conversions are matched to this source by walking the conversation's inbox -> ChatwootInboxIntegration. Unique: one source per inbox integration.

stageEventActionSource.comment: Action source for Opportunity stage-change events sent to Meta. 'system_generated' (default) sends hashed-PII events attributed by Meta via the click id — correct for conversions that happen OUTSIDE the message thread (CRM funnel changes), and accepts any event name. 'business_messaging' sends in-thread events keyed by ctwa_clid/ig_sid + the WABA/IG account id, and only accepts Meta's restricted event vocabulary (e.g. Purchase, LeadSubmitted).

createOpportunity.comment: When true, each ingested conversion creates an Opportunity (linked to the reconciled Contact) in the configured Funnel/Stage. Independent of the CAPI send.

funnel.comment: Funnel where Opportunities will be created for conversions attributed to this source. Required (in UI) only when createOpportunity=true.

opportunityStage.comment: OpportunityStage to use for created Opportunities. Empty = first active stage of the funnel.

assignedUser.comment: Default assignedUser for created Opportunities. Empty = unassigned.

teams.tooltip: Inherited from the parent MetaCapiDataset (auto-set by CascadeTeamsFromMetaCapiDataset hook). Not user-editable — assign teams on the parent dataset.

tenant.tooltip: Inherited from the parent MetaCapiDataset (auto-set by CascadeTenantFromMetaCapiDataset hook).
